newsitem.title: USA: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. hog and cattle slaughter estimates - trade.

text.p: Livestock analysts estimate Friday's hog slaughter from 355,000 to 365,000 head versus 362,000 a week ago and 345,000 a year ago.
Saturday's hog slaughter estimates ranged from 35,000 to 50,000 head versus 40,000 a week ago and 159,000 a year ago.
Cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 125,000 to 133,000 head versus 133,000 a week ago and 131,000 a year ago.
Saturday's cattle slaughter estimates ranged from 24,000 to 30,000 head versus 32,000 a week ago and 41,000 a year ago.
